sourceRefs.locator: Transcription, English translation of EA 2 §§ 1–3, opening and conclusion. Uncertain political context, widows and orphans, ransoming captives, strangers, younger and older visitors.
Book II, chapters 29–31. Clotilda, the vow against the Alamanni, Remigius of Reims and the framing of the baptism in terms of Constantine.

summary.de: Bischof von Reims, der Chlodwig unter anderem zum Loskauf von Gefangenen aufforderte. Gregor schildert ihn als Täufer des Königs.
summary.en: Bishop of Reims who advised Clovis to ransom captives. Gregory describes him baptising the king.
